plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Full project lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis-architect + /spec:genesis-design) → plan → design → build → review, with deterministic workflows, a hook-enforced state machine, per-repo grounding bootstrapped by /spec:init, and rule enforcement generated by /spec:enforce

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git helpers: a fast add-all-and-commit flow (/git:commit), a guided merge with conflict repair and worktree cleanup (/git:merge), and an idempotent per-spec worktree entry (/git:enter-worktree)

plugins.name: autopilot
plugins.description: Remote-controlled spec pipeline daemon: a platform-neutral messaging adapter seam (Telegram v1) that renders fork questions as inline keyboards and routes answers back to pending asks
